findings.issue: Qal passive participle of H6485 stays open among numbered, mustered, and appointed; «registrados» commits to enrollment.
Definite qal active masculine plural participle is the substantive comers; gerund «viniendo» smooths that into present progressive.
Construct צבא plus definite המלחמה is a definite chain; bare «ejército» drops that definiteness.

notes: Person, number, and the חיל versus צבא distinction match the tokens.
